name: Shiori Review
description: A quiet, typographic media theme for an independent literary quarterly of essays and poems. Oat paper, warm stone and sumi ink, with a faded red pencil used for thin bookmark ribbons and rules and a deeper red-brown for links. The masthead sets a huge Source Serif 4 wordmark over a dateline (issue number, season, place and cadence) and a ruled menu row; on phones the wordmark and a Menu button share one line. The home page is a contents page: the issue title and cover beside a numbered index of essays and poems, each with its author, an Essay or Poem chip and a page-like folio in Azeret Mono, with a bookmark ribbon hanging over each part; then a note from the editor, a short subscribe-and-submit note and the journal. The footer is a calm strip of issue covers over the colophon. With Issues (an archive with covers), Submissions, Subscribe, Editors, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The magazine details and the subscription + submissions rates are each one synced pattern. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H5 / F8 / L3 as planned). Colours as planned (oat paper #F3EFE7, warm stone #E0D8C9, sumi ink #1F1D1A, faded red pencil #6A3E35) plus: deep red-brown #5A2E26 for links, buttons' hover, chips' text and small accents (9.9:1 on oat, 8.0:1 on stone, 10.7:1 on paper), muted ink #5E574D for secondary text (6.2:1 on oat, 5.0:1 on stone, 6.7:1 on paper) and paper #FAF8F3 for detail cards. Sumi ink is 14.7:1 on oat, 11.9:1 on stone and 15.8:1 on paper. The faded red #6A3E35 passes AA too (7.8:1 on oat, 6.3:1 on stone) but is kept for the bookmark ribbons, hairline underlines, drop caps and chip borders, at 85% opacity on the ribbons.
